example.title: Middle Creek Bridge, Ventura Road over Middle Creek
example.place: Rose Hill vicinity, Mahaska County, IA

brief: Four-panel Pratt pony truss of a local maker's patent 'pipe truss' type: round steel-pipe top chords and end posts joined by cast-iron hip blocks and bearing shoes, square wrought-iron eyebar bottom chords and round eye-rod diagonals, pin-connected. 50 ft truss span plus a timber-trestle approach span (93 ft overall), 12 ft 9 in roadway of weathered transverse planks with a plank wheel-guard/rail along each side, on timber pile bents. Deep shade of creek-bank trees on a gravel county road; measured drawings of the pipe connections are included.

names.plate: PATENT PIPE TRUSS · J. HOLLISTER MFG. CO. · 1898
